Frequently Asked Questions

Which models of the Europull Bow Shackle EP209 are available?

The Europull Bow Shackle EP209 is available in 9 models: 1.0 Ton, 2.0 Ton, 3.25 Ton, 4.75 Ton, 6.5 Ton, 8.5 Ton, 12.0 Ton, 17.0 Ton, 25.0 Ton. Nominal Size ranges from 3/8" to 1-3/4". Full figures for every model are in the technical specifications table on this page.

Which standard does the Europull Bow Shackle EP209 comply with?

The Europull Bow Shackle EP209 is manufactured to US Fed. Spec. RR-C-271. It is designed with a 6:1 safety factor.

What pin Type does the Europull Bow Shackle EP209 have?

The Europull Bow Shackle EP209's pin Type: Threaded Screw Pin with Flat Eye for Easy Turning.

What safety Factor does the Europull Bow Shackle EP209 have?

The Europull Bow Shackle EP209's safety Factor: 6:1 Design Safety Ratio.

What finish does the Europull Bow Shackle EP209 have?

The Europull Bow Shackle EP209's finish: Hot Dip Galvanized with Red Painted Alloy Pin.
